title: A trial start that waits says why, and a stuck gate cannot starve every complete on the host
description: Drive the real trial admission launcher with stand-in docker and df: a gate start waiting on the disk floor holds no place in the queue, so a verification start runs beside it; a pressure wait past its bound fails as a trial-host fault naming the reading, with no verdict on the head; a waiting verification start shows its reason through complete's output within seconds and fails naming it past its bound; with /tmp a tmpfs under the floor, merge and gate trials put their temporary and HOME directories on the durable root and start, doctor names the root and its fix, and a floor wait is one master status attention line.

steps.name: Exercise the admission launcher, trial, verification and status paths
